text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this secondhand bookstore...
Yeah, it has a nice atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Are those lined up in the storefront...
the "Quarterly Famous Umamusume Stories" series!?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
C-Could it be...
Maybe I'll get to read that phantom column
that never made it into the tankobon volume...!

text_block_list.name: Used Bookstore Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you've got good taste, miss.
I've got other issues too... Wanna take a look?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure...?
Thank you so much! It's like a dream come true...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis was able to spend
a wonderful day off.
